app_draft.name: Vita3K
app_draft.description: Experimental PlayStation Vita emulator
app_draft.long_description: Vita3K is an experimental PlayStation Vita emulator for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android.

app_draft.name: vita_ssh
app_draft.description: SSH client and SSH server for the PlayStation Vita — libssh2 client and libssh sshd, each its own VPK, built with VitaSDK
app_draft.long_description: SSH in both directions on the PlayStation Vita. One tree, one build command, two homebrew apps that install side by side on the same memory card:

app_draft.name: otakio-extensions
app_draft.description: Source extensions (Lua) for Otakio, the PS Vita manga reader
app_draft.long_description: without any source: they are installed from this repository, inside the app.

app_draft.name: VitaCell
app_draft.description: Battery health homebrew for the PS Vita: real readings from the battery controller, history, runtime test, 20 languages.
app_draft.long_description: Homebrew for HENkaku / Enso · 20 languages · read-only · no plugin

app_draft.name: pocketjs
app_draft.description: PocketJS: create UI on every screen you love. JavaScript components drawn as native pixels on handhelds, desktops and embedded screens.
app_draft.long_description: One bundle serves machines of different densities. An application states the hosts it is built for, its viewport and the features it turns on in the `app` section of its `pocket.host.config.ts`, and each host contract must present that viewport before compilation and packaging proceed. With `hosts: ["psp", "vita"]`, run from the application directory:

app_draft.name: fnaf1-ps-vita
app_draft.description: Unofficial PS Vita port of Five Nights at Freddy's using data from the Android 2.0.7 release.
app_draft.long_description: An unofficial PS Vita port of **Five Nights at Freddy's** using the supported Android 2.0.7 data revision.

app_draft.name: vita-coldboot
app_draft.description: PS Vita kernel plugin that performs a single automatic Cold Reset on boot
app_draft.long_description: A lightweight PS Vita kernel plugin (`*KERNEL`) for HENkaku Ensō that automatically performs a single **Cold Reset** (`kscePowerRequestColdReset`) on startup and then lets the system run normally.

app_draft.name: openstrike
app_draft.description: OpenStrike: an open-source, path-traced team shooter (Counter-Strike-like FPS) with real-time ray tracing on ThreeRT.
app_draft.long_description: in the game, and play them path traced. They are converted on your device and never leave it.

app_draft.name: pokerogue-vita
app_draft.description: Unofficial PS Vita homebrew client for PokeRogue (beta): plays the live game online with cloud saves, or offline, in an embedded QuickJS runtime with native rendering
app_draft.long_description: An unofficial PlayStation Vita homebrew client for PokeRogue. It runs the **live pokerogue.net game**, which means automatic updates, online accounts and cloud saves, much like the online mode of Admiral-Billy's PokeRogue App on desktop and Android. It can also play an offline build of the game from the memory card.

app_draft.name: engram-vita
app_draft.description: Engram is a set of tweaks for the PS Vita's home screen, set in **Settings → System → Engram**. Its settings are grouped by category. There are two, **Live Area** and **Fonts**.

app_draft.name: gow-collection-nx
app_draft.description: God of War & God of War II (PS Vita) recompiled for Nintendo Switch homebrew - libnx + Vulkan (NVK) port on vitaRT. No game files included. Guto Recomp v1.0
app_draft.long_description: Os executáveis de *God of War* e *God of War II* do PS Vita são **recompilados estaticamente** para C pelo recompilador do vitaRT e depois **compilados nativamente para o ARM64 do Switch**.

app_draft.name: otakio
app_draft.description: Manga reader for the PS Vita: library, reader, offline downloads, CBZ import and Lua source extensions
app_draft.long_description: Sources are small Lua files published in an *extension repository* (an `index.json` plus `.lua` files). The project's repository is **Garryth69/otakio-extensions**, kept separate from the app.

app_draft.name: AreaPlay
app_draft.description: A fast, good-looking game hub for PS Vita: PS Vita, PSP, PS1, retro systems and homebrews in one place, with automatic covers.
app_draft.long_description: It is an app launched from its bubble, on top of LiveArea: nothing is replaced on the system, and you can remove it like any other app.

app_draft.name: glitch-blocks
app_draft.description: 8x8 block-placement puzzle for PS Vita homebrew (VitaSDK, MIT)
app_draft.long_description: An 8x8 block-placement puzzle for the PS Vita, as homebrew for consoles running HENkaku (or another taiHEN-based homebrew enabler). Drop pieces from a tray of three onto the grid, fill rows and columns to clear them, and keep going as long as anything still fits. Neon-on-black look, synthesised chiptune audio, no network, no ads.

app_draft.name: PSX2PSP-Reborn
app_draft.description: Native Rust POPS EBOOT.PBP builder for PSP & PS Vita: bit-perfect PBP, multi-disc, live GPU XMB preview, ICON1/SND0 from YouTube, built-in patch database for ~2,000 PS1 games.
app_draft.long_description: One native binary. Bit-perfect PBP, multi-disc up to five, a game patch database with ~2,000 titles, an animated ICON1.PMF and SND0.AT3 cut from any YouTube video , and a live, GPU-rendered XMB that shows the result before you copy it to the memory stick.

app_draft.name: combo-peel-vita
app_draft.description: Plugin para PS Vita: desbloqueia a tela de bloqueio com analógico ↓ + X
app_draft.long_description: Plugin de kernel (taiHEN) para PS Vita, do tipo **qualidade de vida (QoL)**: desbloqueia a tela de bloqueio com um combo de botões, com a mesma animação de "descascar" (peel) do gesto com o dedo.

app_draft.name: VitaIPTV
app_draft.description: Native IPTV player for PS Vita / PS TV – M3U, Xtream, HLS, HTTPS
app_draft.long_description: A native IPTV player for the PlayStation Vita and PS TV (HENkaku / Ensō). Watch live TV, films and series and listen to radio from your own M3U playlists or Xtream accounts, decoded by the Vita's hardware H.264 decoder.

app_draft.name: vita-save-sync
app_draft.description: Keep your PSP saves in sync between a PS Vita (VitaShell FTP) and PPSSPP on Windows.
app_draft.long_description: Play a PSP game on the Vita, carry on in PPSSPP on your PC, then go back to the Vita. Vita Save Sync copies each save to the side where it's out of date. It connects to the Vita over Wi‑Fi through VitaShell's built-in FTP server, so you don't need a USB cable.

app_draft.name: mkxp-z-vita
app_draft.description: HardRPG: play RPG Maker XP, VX, VX Ace, 2000 and 2003 games on PS Vita.
app_draft.long_description: Copy your games to the Vita and play them from a game library with covers. XP, VX and VX Ace games run natively on mkxp-z-vita, this repository's Vita port of mkxp-z. RPG Maker 2000 and 2003 games run on the EasyRPG Player that comes built in. RPG Maker Dante 98 and Dante 98 II games (the PC-98 RPG Makers) run natively on a built-in port of OpenDT. It is free, open source homebrew for any Vita with HENkaku or Ensō.

app_draft.name: vitaftpshell
app_draft.description: Twin-pane FTP client, local file manager, and anonymous FTP server for the PS Vita in a Cyberpunk HUD. Pre-alpha.
app_draft.long_description: vitaFTPShell is one PS Vita app with three roles: a passive FTP client, a local file manager over every mounted user volume, and an anonymous read-write FTP server. The console is the workspace, not a remote endpoint driven from a PC.

app_draft.name: Art3m1sPSV
app_draft.description: 面向 PlayStation Vita 的 Artemis 游戏运行器，基于第三方实现 Art3m1s 开发。解析与运行时以 **Alphaly2K/art3m1s-core** 为基础，为 PSV 补充了部分较新引擎的脚本行为，并调整了渲染、资源缓存、音视频和输入处理。

app_draft.name: plus-vita
app_draft.description: Native PlayStation Vita client for PlayStation Plus cloud gaming
app_draft.long_description: Plus-Vita lets you play eligible **PlayStation Plus cloud games directly on your PlayStation Vita**. You need your own Sony account and

app_draft.name: PSVSend
app_draft.description: A Localsend compatible client for PS Vita.
app_draft.long_description: 面向 **PS Vita** 的 LocalSend 协议兼容客户端，可在同一局域网内与其他 LocalSend 设备（手机、PC）互相传输文件。

app_draft.name: joey-passion-recomp
app_draft.description: Native macOS, Windows, Android and PS Vita port of Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Joey the Passion via static x86-to-C recompilation (bring your own game files)
app_draft.long_description: A native port of **Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Joey the Passion** (Konami, PC 2004) to **macOS, Windows, Android and PS Vita**, made by **static recompilation**. The original Win32 x86 executable (`Joey_Pc.exe`) is translated to C, compiled natively for each platform and run on a small reimplementation of the parts of Windows and DirectX the game uses.

app_draft.name: fukufuku-no-shima-english-patch
app_draft.description: Fukufuku no Shima (福福の島) English patch – fan translation of the Japan-only PSP game (UCJS-10016). Patch your ISO with xdelta and play on PPSSPP, PSP or PS Vita.
app_draft.long_description: A fan-made English translation patch for the Japan-only PlayStation Portable game.
